/* module: home/HomeScene */
/** HomeScene owns the approved visual composition ONLY. No gameplay lives here. */
function mountHome(target) {
    target.innerHTML = `<main class="game" id="game-root">${APPROVED_HOME_SVG}</main>
    <div id="panel-backdrop" aria-hidden="true"><div class="panel" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="panel-title" tabindex="-1"><button type="button" id="close-panel" aria-label="Close menu">×</button><div id="panel-content"></div></div></div>
    <div id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>`;
    const svg = target.querySelector('#home-art');
    if (!svg)
        throw new Error('Approved HomeScene SVG did not mount');
    return svg;
}

/* module: home/responsive */
/* Approved responsive composition from most recently accepted home. */
function attachHomeResponsive(scene) {
    const get = (id) => {
        const node = scene.querySelector(`#${id}`);
        if (!node)
            throw new Error(`Ally Quest scene missing ${id}`);
        return node;
    };
    const keys = ['landscape', 'tree-left', 'tree-right', 'brand', 'stars', 'nav-settings', 'main-logo', 'friends', 'foreground-grounding', 'nav-play', 'nav-map', 'nav-crew', 'nav-workshop', 'nav-daily'];
    const nodes = Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k => [k, get(k)]));
    const set = (key, transform) => nodes[key].setAttribute('transform', transform);
    let frame = 0;
    function resize() {
        frame = 0;
        const width = Math.max(250, window.innerWidth);
        const height = Math.max(300, window.innerHeight);
        const ratio = width / height;
        if (ratio >= 1.08) {
            document.body.classList.remove('portrait');
            const virtualWidth = Math.max(544, 350 * ratio);
            scene.setAttribute('viewBox', `${(544 - virtualWidth) / 2} 0 ${virtualWidth} 350`);
            scene.setAttribute('preserveAspectRatio', 'xMidYMid meet');
            set('landscape', 'translate(0 0)');
            set('tree-left', 'translate(-20 109) scale(1 1)');
            set('tree-right', 'translate(562 94) scale(-1 1)');
            // HUD corners are anchored to the visible viewBox edges, not to
            // the original 544 px artwork. This keeps them in the corners
            // even on 21:9 and other wide displays.
            const visibleLeft = (544 - virtualWidth) / 2;
            const visibleRight = visibleLeft + virtualWidth;
            const hudLeft = visibleLeft + 9;
            const hudRight = visibleRight - 20;
            set('brand', `translate(${hudLeft - 24} 0)`);
            set('stars', `translate(${hudRight - 513 - 7} 0)`);
            set('nav-settings', `translate(${hudRight - 513} 0)`);
            set('main-logo', 'translate(39 7) scale(.85)');
            set('friends', 'translate(0 0)');
            set('foreground-grounding', 'translate(0 0)');
            // Equispaced navigation. Expanded on widescreens; the art stays editable.
            const spread = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (virtualWidth - 544) / 142));
            set('nav-play', `translate(${-24 - 20 * spread} 0)`);
            set('nav-map', `translate(${-10 - 10 * spread} 0)`);
            set('nav-crew', 'translate(0 0)');
            set('nav-workshop', `translate(${10 + 10 * spread} 0)`);
            set('nav-daily', `translate(${21 + 23 * spread} 0)`);
        }
        else {
            document.body.classList.add('portrait');
            const h = 360 / ratio;
            scene.setAttribute('viewBox', `0 0 360 ${h}`);
            scene.setAttribute('preserveAspectRatio', 'xMidYMid meet');
            set('landscape', 'translate(-110 145) scale(1.05)');
            // Re-anchor the illustrated trees to the ground on the portrait edges.
            set('tree-left', 'translate(100 109) scale(1 1)');
            set('tree-right', 'translate(450 94) scale(-1 1)');
            // On portrait displays the badge remains safely inside the left
            // edge; the two score/settings controls share a top baseline.
            set('brand', 'translate(-11 11) scale(.78)');
            set('stars', 'translate(-74 15) scale(.80)');
            set('nav-settings', 'translate(-63 14) scale(.78)');
            set('main-logo', `translate(-40 ${h * .125}) scale(.77)`);
            const charsY = Math.max(292, h * .40);
            set('friends', `translate(-5 ${charsY}) scale(.68)`);
            set('foreground-grounding', `translate(-5 ${charsY}) scale(.68)`);
            set('nav-play', `translate(29 ${h - 525}) scale(1.25)`);
            const rowY = h - 406;
            set('nav-map', `translate(-224 ${rowY}) scale(1.15)`);
            set('nav-crew', `translate(-228 ${rowY}) scale(1.15)`);
            set('nav-workshop', `translate(-234 ${rowY}) scale(1.15)`);
            set('nav-daily', `translate(-251 ${rowY}) scale(1.15)`);
        }
        scene.dataset.layout = ratio >= 1.08 ? 'landscape' : 'portrait';
        scene.dataset.viewport = `${width}x${height}`;
    }
    const observer = () => {
        if (!frame) {
            frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => { frame = 0; resize(); });
        }
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', observer, { passive: true });
    resize();
    return () => {
        window.removeEventListener('resize', observer);
        if (frame)
            cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
}

/* module: state/saveData */
/** No profiles, identifiers, trackers, network or child personal data. */
const STORAGE_KEY = 'allyquest.progress.v1';
function safeStorage() {
    try {
        return typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.localStorage : null;
    }
    catch {
        return null;
    }
}
const defaultSave = () => ({ version: 1, totalStars: 0, completedLevels: [], chairColor: '#f2c365', motionEnabled: true });
const safeColors = ['#f2c365', '#80c8d8', '#b69add', '#9bcf91'];
const SWATCHES = safeColors;
function sanitizeSave(value) {
    const d = defaultSave();
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object')
        return d;
    const x = value;
    if (x.version !== 1)
        return d;
    const stars = Number(x.totalStars);
    return {
        version: 1,
        totalStars: Number.isSafeInteger(stars) && stars >= 0 && stars <= 900 ? stars : 0,
        completedLevels: Array.isArray(x.completedLevels) ? x.completedLevels.filter((v) => typeof v === 'string' && /^[a-z0-9-]{1,48}$/.test(v)).slice(0, 300) : [],
        chairColor: typeof x.chairColor === 'string' && safeColors.includes(x.chairColor) ? x.chairColor : d.chairColor,
        motionEnabled: typeof x.motionEnabled === 'boolean' ? x.motionEnabled : d.motionEnabled,
    };
}
class SaveStore {
    storage;
    data;
    constructor(storage = safeStorage()) {
        this.storage = storage;
        let data;
        try {
            data = JSON.parse(this.storage?.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) ?? 'null');
        }
        catch {
            data = null;
        }
        this.data = sanitizeSave(data);
    }
    get snapshot() { return { ...this.data, completedLevels: [...this.data.completedLevels] }; }
    update(next) {
        this.data = sanitizeSave({ ...this.data, ...next, version: 1 });
        try {
            this.storage?.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.data));
        }
        catch { /* private browsing / storage disabled */ }
    }
    /** Called only by future, real LevelCompleted events. Never grant stars from a menu. */
    finishLevel(levelId, earnedStars) {
        if (!/^[a-z0-9-]{1,48}$/.test(levelId))
            throw new Error('Invalid level ID');
        const points = Math.min(3, Math.max(0, Math.floor(earnedStars)));
        if (!this.data.completedLevels.includes(levelId))
            this.update({ totalStars: this.data.totalStars + points, completedLevels: [...this.data.completedLevels, levelId] });
    }
}

/* module: ui/Overlay */
/** Accessible modal host; only approved home SVG changes are event listeners. */
class Overlay {
    previousFocus = null;
    backdrop = document.getElementById('panel-backdrop');
    content = document.getElementById('panel-content');
    closeButton = document.getElementById('close-panel');
    toast = document.getElementById('toast');
    toastTimer;
    constructor() {
        this.closeButton.addEventListener('click', () => this.close());
        this.backdrop.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => { if (event.target === this.backdrop)
            this.close(); });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
            if (!this.isOpen())
                return;
            if (event.key === 'Escape') {
                event.preventDefault();
                this.close();
                return;
            }
            if (event.key !== 'Tab')
                return;
            const focusable = Array.from(this.backdrop.querySelectorAll('button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), a[href], [tabindex="0"]')).filter(el => el.getClientRects().length);
            if (!focusable.length)
                return;
            const index = focusable.indexOf(document.activeElement);
            if (event.shiftKey && index <= 0) {
                event.preventDefault();
                focusable.at(-1)?.focus();
            }
            else if (!event.shiftKey && (index === focusable.length - 1 || index === -1)) {
                event.preventDefault();
                focusable[0]?.focus();
            }
        });
    }
    isOpen() { return this.backdrop.classList.contains('open'); }
    open(title, markup) {
        this.previousFocus = document.activeElement;
        const h = document.createElement('h2');
        h.id = 'panel-title';
        h.textContent = title;
        this.content.replaceChildren();
        const header = document.createElement('header');
        header.className = 'panel-head';
        header.appendChild(h);
        this.content.appendChild(header);
        const body = document.createElement('div');
        body.innerHTML = markup;
        this.content.appendChild(body);
        this.backdrop.classList.add('open');
        this.backdrop.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
        this.closeButton.focus();
        return body;
    }
    close() { this.backdrop.classList.remove('open'); this.backdrop.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); this.content.replaceChildren(); this.previousFocus?.focus(); }
    alert(text) { this.toast.textContent = text; this.toast.classList.add('show'); clearTimeout(this.toastTimer); this.toastTimer = window.setTimeout(() => this.toast.classList.remove('show'), 2100); }
}

/* module: ui/routes */
const CHARACTER_ART = {"ethan": "data:image/png;base64,
